question: Does the prospective four-home x three-cell point compose under synchronized physical execution on four A100 GPUs and cross the one-home receiver-memory boundary?
canary_outcome: PASS after using a 1--4-cell sharded controller and fail-fast controller/worker join order.
mode: four A100 homes; each GPU runs three-cell Aerial/cuPHY, two same-device IPC NRx endpoints, and Qwen2.5-1.5B; CUDA_MODULE_LOADING=LAZY; MPS; mixed correlated faults; P180/D155; synchronized releases
gate_rule: Both independent arms must have identical first release across four homes, overlapping physical timed intervals, 4080 radio records, exact worker/controller counts, positive atomic exchange and timely AI in every home, zero system safety/credit/fault violations, and unchanged source/artifact hashes.
claim_rule: A pass validates finite-sample disjoint-home certificate composition and horizontal receiver-memory scaling at the prospectively selected 4-home x 3-cell point. It does not validate shared endpoints, global cross-home AI leases, WCET, or production DU timing.
